single_stage.name: reservation_first_granular_contract_and_isolated_python_controller_validation
ordered_steps: verify exact native image, complete static/predecessor closure, and future different-reviewer audit
use an exact-subject identity-capture function only for a newly observed handle and a separate bound-identity recheck function for every retained handle
open and retain the exact v3r20 authority contract before accepting the audit, and bind its digest and file identity into both durable records
CREATE_NEW fixed evidence and receipt and durably read back the reservation
open the exact v3r15 contract once and prove attributes, size, final path, file identity, and two SHA-256 snapshots granularly on that same retained handle
open and retain exact manifest, Python DLL, stdlib zip, controller, and execution contract
prove exactly one retained-manifest row for every retained runtime subject
delayed-load only the exact retained Python DLL
initialize an isolated interpreter and evaluate only inert controller definitions
verify exactly five callable exports and strict execution-contract projection
finalize Python, release its DLL, prove the old module base and exact Python DLL path are absent from a fail-closed process-module inventory, and recheck every retained identity and digest
recheck the retained v3r20 authority contract on its original handle before terminal completion
recheck and close the original contract handle and durably store granular terminal telemetry

file_identity_repair.capture_operation: verify exact regular file, bytes, final path and SHA-256, then return observed FILE_ID_INFO
file_identity_repair.bound_operation: run the capture operation into a fresh local value, then compare it to the previously retained FILE_ID_INFO
